backend-booking: Booking system backend with services catalog and user bookings. Read handler for available time slots and write handler for creating bookings.
backend-crm: CRM backend with contacts, deals pipeline, and task management models. Handlers for fetching contact deals and deals by pipeline stage.
backend-dashboard-analytics: Dashboard analytics backend with sales and products models. Read handlers for fetching sales data, products, and aggregated dashboard statistics.
backend-ecommerce: E-commerce backend with products catalog, orders, and order items models. Handlers for product category queries, order creation, and order history retrieval.
backend-helpdesk: Helpdesk backend with support tickets and comments models. Read handler for filtering tickets by status and write handler for assigning tickets to agents.
backend-internal-tool: Internal tool backend with user management and audit logging models. Read handler for audit logs and write handler for updating user roles.
backend-inventory: Inventory management backend with products and stock movements models. Read handler for low stock items alert and write handler for recording stock movements.
backend-project-management: Project management backend with projects and tasks models. Read handler for project tasks and write handler for moving tasks between kanban columns.
